title: The Year the Web Went Wireless
narrative: Napster kills the music industry. Wi-Fi untethers the internet. EverQuest creates addiction. Palm V puts computing in your pocket. Broadband replaces dial-up. The world prepares for Y2K while the future silently arrives.
